At Episto, I manage agendas, maintain CRM records, coordinate content publication, and prepare reports for client projects. I independently plan and execute website projects from start to finish, demonstrating proactive organisation and attention to detail. Comfortable communicating with diverse stakeholders in English, Turkish, and Dutch (B1, currently improving). Experienced in Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams) and quick to learn new tools. Based in Zwijndrecht, next to Antwerp. Seeking a Management Assistant role where I can provide reliable support to management and contribute to a positive, efficient work environment.
